name: Periscope Pub Bangers and Mash with Onion Gravy (Disney Treasure)
whyItWorks: The creamy mashed potato base is soothing, but traditional British pork sausages have tough casings/high fat and the gravy is loaded with caramelized onions.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Eat the mashed potatoes (ask for onion gravy on the side) and peel the outer sausage casing if tasting in remission.
watchOuts: Pork sausage fat and tough casing
